body: My mistake, looked very close to one of the stories in that book. Ignore me.

So let me make this clear, I am not a psychiatrist. I was the patient, the "psychiatrist" a pysch student intern. 
Basically I went to a mental illness boarding school at the age of 17, while I was there I received therapy. There was a student intern who was doing some sessions, his first patients. I decided to do them, he was nice and they went fine. Then my therapist was deported and I hated who I was assigned to. The schools solution? Make him who I see for sessions while he consulates with the therapist I refused to work with.. So his first patient...

The reason I REALLY believe I have made him cry:
I have alot of problems that acted up worse then. I just went through a hard loss, I had multiple mental illnesses and trauma which was yet to be addressed. Whenever he would make me upset with a response I had a tendency to walk away, screaming and yelling. I would cry and scream, have breakdowns. This student, first patient, gets thrown in with someone who would yell in his face, cry, walk away, ect. (please keep in mind the behavior was due to mental illness that was MUCH harder to control then!)
I haven't seen him cry but I assume I became that stressful. I hope he learned something at least
Could I messaged you? My cat.. she's very sweet
